text: dsh-mobile 是面向 DSH Web 的手机任务工作台，在窄屏中提供任务、会话和设备三个入口。它从 Host 读取会话与工作区，按待处理、运行中和就绪状态组织任务，并可搜索、创建任务、查看会话概览或切换完整记录。紧凑输入支持发送文字和停止任务，复杂输入可返回完整编辑器。适合希望在手机浏览器中处理 DSH 会话的用户；需要 DSH Web，远程访问需另配远程控制插件。

dsh-mobile adds task, session, and device views to DSH Web on a phone. It sorts Host sessions by status, supports search and task creation, and shows an overview or full record. Compact input sends text or stops tasks; complex input uses the full editor. Remote access needs a separate plugin.
我想在手机浏览器里查看和处理 DSH 会话。
能把待处理的会话排在列表前面吗？
我需要在手机上搜索工作区和任务名称。
想快速查看会话进展和最近完成的回复。
能在手机上发送消息并停止正在运行的任务吗？
如何从简洁输入切回完整对话编辑器？
I want to browse and continue my DSH sessions from a phone.
Can I see pending approvals and recent completed replies at a glance?
dsh-mobile 的功能「任务列表」：任务页按待处理、运行中和就绪状态排序会话，并支持搜索及在已有工作区中新建任务。
dsh-mobile 的功能「会话概览」：打开会话可先查看已有历史中的进展、待处理事项和已完成回复，再切换到完整记录。
dsh-mobile 的功能「紧凑输入」：手机工作台提供文字输入、发送和停止操作；附件等复杂输入会切回完整编辑器。
dsh-mobile 的功能「设备与桌面切换」：设备页可切回桌面布局；与远程控制插件配合时，还可修改当前配对设备名称。

dsh-mobile README · dsh-mobile：简体中文 | [English](README.en.md)

[DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的全屏手机工作台，以任务为中心组织需要你处理的工作、会话概览和继续对话的入口，使用同一个 DSH Host 与会话记录。

这是独立维护的社区 UI 插件，可在能够访问 DSH 的浏览器中单独使用。如需临时 HTTPS 远程入口与手机配对，可加装 [dsh-remote-control](https://github.com/slicenferqin/dsh-remote-control)；当前完整手机体验建议两个都装。

dsh-mobile README · 宣传片：https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/763e9698-6479-40da-9685-b201a600c2e4

[下载完整 MP4](https://github.com/slicenferqin/dsh-mobile/releases/download/v0.1.0/DSH-Anywhere-30s.mp4) · [GIF 预览](https://github.com/slicenferqin/dsh-mobile/releases/download/v0.1.0/DSH-Anywhere-preview.gif) · [封面](https://github.com/slicenferqin/dsh-mobile/releases/download/v0.1.0/DSH-Anywhere-cover.png)

30 秒宣传片，16:9、1080p 60 fps，使用原创音乐与音效，中文画面，无口播。

dsh-mobile README · 界面预览：

截图使用中文界面和公开演示会话。

dsh-mobile README · 功能：- **任务：** 优先排列待你处理的工作，再显示进行中和已就绪会话；按名称或工作区搜索，在已有工作区中新建任务。
- **概览：** 查看待处理问题或审批、当前阶段、最近正文进展、最新已完成回复及折叠的此前结果。
- **完整记录：** 使用 DSH 原有会话渲染器查看历史、工具详情、图片和交互。
- **简洁输入：** 发送文字和停止任务；通过 **更多工具** 打开完整编辑器。包含附件、结构化引用或命令时会自动恢复完整编辑器。
- **设备：** 配合 dsh-remote-control 修改当前已配对设备名称，或切回桌面界面。

概览只是已有会话原文与状态的展示投影，**不是模型生成的摘要，也不会额外调用模型**。

dsh-mobile README · 兼容性：- **Node.js 22.19 或更新版本**，已安装 DSH；profile 包管理需要 `PATH` 中有 `pnpm`。
- 声明的 DSH 版本范围：`>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`。Client / Slot API 尚未稳定，升级 DSH 可能需要同步更新插件。
- 已在 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 源码构建版、macOS arm64** 上完成 live 浏览器验证；并未对所有操作系统、浏览器和设备组合完成端到端验证。
- 本版面向 DSH Web UI。宽屏桌面窗口默认保持原布局。

dsh-mobile README · 安装与启动：通过 GitHub tag 安装到 Web profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:slicenferqin/dsh-mobile#v0.1.0
```

如需通过临时 HTTPS 隧道从手机访问，再安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:slicenferqin/dsh-remote-control#v0.3.1
```

使用 `dsh web`（或 `dsh --profile web`）启动。若已运行，CLI 安装后请重启该 profile，再刷新页面。[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/slicenferqin/dsh-mobile/releases) 也提供发行压缩包，无需发布到 npm。

dsh-mobile README · 安装与启动：DSH 默认 Web 监听位于电脑本机（`127.0.0.1`），dsh-mobile 本身不会将其开放给手机。远程使用请按 [remote-control 安装与配对文档](https://github.com/slicenferqin/dsh-remote-control#安装与启动) 操作：在电脑安装 cloudflared，打开 **设置 → 远程控制**，扫码后确认设备名称，再明确点击 **配对并进入**。Quick Tunnel 无需 Cloudflare 账号或域名，但首次启动可能接近一分钟。其桥接要求 DSH origin 使用 `localhost`、`127.0.0.1` 或 `[::1]`，不支持 LAN 地址及通配监听目标。

dsh-mobile README · 使用与配置：窗口宽度**不超过 900 CSS 像素**时自动进入工作台。底部提供 **任务、会话、设备** 三个入口。打开任务默认显示概览；切换到 **完整记录** 可进入完整对话界面。新任务使用已有 DSH 工作区；缺少工作区时，请先在桌面界面创建。

在 **设备 → 切回桌面界面** 返回原界面。窄屏桌面界面底部提供恢复手机工作台的按钮。设置侧栏没有单独的手机工作台入口。

本版没有 Host 配置字段。布局偏好与选中会话只存储在当前浏览器。默认自动模式不改变宽屏桌面布局；手动恢复工作台的偏好会作用于该浏览器。

dsh-mobile README · 限制与安全范围：概览只使用**已加载的会话历史**，展示最新已完成的文字回复和最多三条此前已完成结果，不表示已概括全部存储历史，也不根据未完成正文推断任务完成。概览不展示推理、原始工具参数、图片和长日志；请在 **完整记录** 查看，通过 **更多工具** 使用复杂输入或操作。

插件展示现有 DSH 数据，沿用原有会话、输入、排队、停止、提问和审批机制，不新增网络监听、远程访问服务、独立账号或权限边界。所有操作继续受 Host 的既有权限约束。设备自助更名需要通过 remote-control 配对连接；其他工作台功能不依赖该插件。

dsh-mobile README · 限制与安全范围：配合 dsh-remote-control 时，已配对手机拥有 **Host 的 owner 权限**，包括其权限策略允许的本机文件及命令能力。这不是只读界面或操作系统远程桌面，也不会锁定电脑。详见 [远程插件的安全范围与有效期说明](https://github.com/slicenferqin/dsh-remote-control#安全范围与限制)。默认 8 小时访问有效期和滚动 10 天刷新窗口仅适用于同一远程入口持续运行：关闭入口、重启 DSH、重载 Host 插件或更换隧道域名都会清空配对。

dsh-mobile README · 开发与测试：包中包含可读源码、构建脚本和测试。在仓库根目录或解压后的源码包中执行：

```sh
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
pnpm run build
pnpm run check
pnpm test

构建会打包 Markdown 解析与净化依赖；运行时从 DSH Host 加载 React。测试覆盖概览正文选择、完成证据、历史数量边界、进展和待处理事项优先级，不能替代浏览器及设备验证。本地试用可在仓库根目录运行 `dsh plugin --profile web add .` 安装 checkout，然后重启 Web profile 并刷新页面。

dsh-mobile README · dsh-mobile：[简体中文](README.md) | English

A task-first, full-screen phone workspace for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Find work that needs your attention, read a session overview, and continue the conversation using the same DSH Host and records.

dsh-mobile README · dsh-mobile：This is an independent community UI plugin. It can run on its own in a reachable DSH browser. Add [dsh-remote-control](https://github.com/slicenferqin/dsh-remote-control) for temporary HTTPS access and phone pairing; install both for the current full phone experience.

dsh-mobile README · Preview：

The screenshot uses the Chinese locale and a public demo session.

dsh-mobile README · Features：- **Tasks:** prioritize work waiting for you, then running and ready sessions; search by title or workspace and start a task in an existing workspace.
- **Overview:** show pending questions/approvals, the current stage, recent reply text, the latest completed reply, and collapsible earlier results.
- **Full record:** use DSH's existing conversation renderer for history, tool details, images, and interactions.
- **Compact input:** send text and stop tasks; **More tools** opens the full editor. Attachments, structured references, or commands automatically restore the full editor.
- **Device:** rename the current paired device when used with dsh-remote-control, or switch back to the desktop interface.
dsh-mobile README · Features：Overviews project text and state already present in the session. They are **not model-generated summaries** and make **no additional model calls**.

dsh-mobile README · Compatibility：- Node.js **22.19 or later**, DSH installed, and `pnpm` on `PATH` for profile package management.
- Declared DSH range: `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`. The Client/Slot APIs are pre-stable; upgrades may require plugin updates.
- Validated with a **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 source build on macOS arm64**, including live browser use. Other OS/browser/device combinations have not all been validated end to end.
- This release targets the DSH Web UI. A wide desktop window keeps its normal layout by default.

dsh-mobile README · Install and start：Install the tagged release into the Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:slicenferqin/dsh-mobile#v0.1.0
```

For access from your phone over a temporary HTTPS tunnel, also install:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:slicenferqin/dsh-remote-control#v0.3.1
```

dsh-mobile README · Install and start：Start DSH with `dsh web` (or `dsh --profile web`). If already running, restart that profile after the CLI installation, then refresh the page. Release tarballs are also available from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/slicenferqin/dsh-mobile/releases); npm publication is not required.

dsh-mobile README · Install and start：DSH's default Web listener is local to the computer (`127.0.0.1`); dsh-mobile itself does not expose it to a phone. For remote use, follow the [remote-control installation and pairing guide](https://github.com/slicenferqin/dsh-remote-control/blob/main/README.en.md#install-and-start): install cloudflared on the computer, enable **Settings → Remote control**, scan the QR code, confirm the device name, and explicitly tap **Pair and enter**. A Quick Tunnel needs no Cloudflare account or domain, but first startup can take nearly a minute. Its bridge requires a DSH origin using `localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, or `[::1]`, and does not support LAN/wildcard targets.

dsh-mobile README · Use and configuration：The workspace opens automatically at a viewport width of **900 CSS pixels or less**. Bottom navigation provides **Tasks**, **Session**, and **Device**. Open a task to start with its overview; switch to **Full record** for the complete conversation UI. New tasks use an existing DSH workspace; create any missing workspace in the desktop interface first.

dsh-mobile README · Use and configuration：Under **Device → Switch to desktop**, return to the original interface. On narrow screens, a button at the bottom of the desktop interface restores the phone workspace. There is no separate phone-workspace entry in the Settings sidebar.

dsh-mobile README · Use and configuration：There are no Host configuration fields in this release. Layout and selected-session preferences are stored only in the current browser. The default automatic layout leaves wide desktop windows unchanged; a manually restored phone-workspace preference applies to that browser.

dsh-mobile README · Limits and security scope：The overview uses **loaded session history**, showing the latest completed text reply and up to three earlier completed results. It does not claim to summarize the entire stored history or infer completion from unfinished text. Reasoning, raw tool arguments, images, and long logs are outside the overview; use **Full record** for them and **More tools** for complex input or actions.

dsh-mobile README · Limits and security scope：The plugin presents existing DSH data and uses its session, input, queue, stop, question, and approval mechanisms. It does not add a network listener, remote-access service, separate account, or permission boundary. Actions retain the Host's existing permissions. Device self-renaming requires a paired remote-control connection; the rest of the workspace works without that plugin.

dsh-mobile README · Limits and security scope：With dsh-remote-control, a paired phone has **owner access to the Host**, including available local-file and command capabilities under its permission policy. It is not a read-only view or OS remote desktop, and it does not lock the computer. See the [remote plugin's security and lifetime documentation](https://github.com/slicenferqin/dsh-remote-control/blob/main/README.en.md#security-scope-and-limits). Its default 8-hour access and rolling 10-day refresh window apply only while the same remote entry continues running: disabling it, restarting DSH, reloading the Host plugin, or changing tunnel domain clears pairings.

dsh-mobile README · Development and tests：Readable source, build scripts, and tests are included. From a checkout or extracted source package:

```sh
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
pnpm run build
pnpm run check
pnpm test

dsh-mobile README · Development and tests：The build bundles Markdown parsing and sanitization and loads React from the DSH Host at runtime. Tests cover overview text selection, completion evidence, history bounds, progress, and pending-interaction priority. They do not replace browser/device checks. To try a local checkout, run `dsh plugin --profile web add .` from this repository's root, then restart the Web profile and refresh its page.

dsh-mobile README · 限制与安全范围：配合 dsh-remote-control 时，已配对手机拥有 **Host 的 owner 权限**，包括其权限策略允许的本机文件及命令能力。这不是只读界面或操作系统远程桌面，也不会锁定电脑。详见 [远程插件的安全范围与有效期说明](https://github.com/slicenferqin/dsh-remote-control#安全范围与限制)。默认 8 小时访问有效期和滚动 10 天刷新窗口仅适用于同一远程入口持续运行：关闭入口、重启 DSH、重载 Host 插件或更换隧道域名都会清空配对。

dsh-mobile README · 开发与测试：包中包含可读源码、构建脚本和测试。在仓库根目录或解压后的源码包中执行：

```sh
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
pnpm run build
pnpm run check
pnpm test

构建会打包 Markdown 解析与净化依赖；运行时从 DSH Host 加载 React。测试覆盖概览正文选择、完成证据、历史数量边界、进展和待处理事项优先级，不能替代浏览器及设备验证。本地试用可在仓库根目录运行 `dsh plugin --profile web add .` 安装 checkout，然后重启 Web profile 并刷新页面。
